404 Not Found when retrieving a nonexistent response

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"

    try {
    val apiKey = requireNotNull(System.getenv("API_KEY")) { "API_KEY must be set" }
    val result = LiterLlm.createClient(apiKey = apiKey).use { client -> client.retrieveResponse("resp-nonexistent") }
```
